mapper.update: UPDATE sector SET status = '사용가능' WHERE sector_id IN ( SELECT sector_id FROM ( SELECT rh.sector_id FROM rent_history rh JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(rent_end_date) AS max_rent_end_date FROM rent_history GROUP BY user_id ) latest_rent ON rh.user_id = latest_rent.user_id AND rh.rent_end_date = latest_rent.max_rent_end_date WHERE rh.rent_end_date < NOW() ) AS recent_sector )
